info.title: Magica Agent Chat API
info.description: Public REST API for Magica Agent Chat: conversational AI runs, multi-turn tool execution, live streaming tokens, credit hold/settlement ledger, and human approval waitpoints.

bearerAuth.description: Clerk session token passed as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

get.description: Returns service status. Does not require authentication.
Returns the authenticated user's ID and account creation timestamp.
Returns the authenticated user's current balance in microcredits (1,000,000 microcredits = 1 credit).
Returns paginated ledger entries (grants, reserves, settlements, refunds) showing exact credit audit history.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return (default 20, max 50)

get.description: Returns paginated chats owned by the user, sorted with pinned chats first, then newest first. Supports search filtering with `q`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of chats to return (default 20, max 50)

post.description: Creates a new empty chat conversation.

patch.description: Renames a chat title or pins/unpins it.

delete.description: Deletes a chat and all associated messages, runs, and tool invocations.

get.description: Returns paginated messages for a chat in reverse chronological order (newest first).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of messages to return (default 20, max 50)

post.description: Appends a user message to the chat and triggers an asynchronous agent run. Returns the run ID and a read-only Trigger.dev realtime token to stream text and tool steps live.

requestBody.description: Message content, clientRequestId for idempotency, and optional planMode

200.description: Message sent and agent run dispatched

409.description: Run already active for this chat

get.description: Returns the current in-flight agent run for a chat (status 'queued', 'running', or 'waiting'). Includes a fresh realtime token and any pending waitpoint. Returns null if no run is active.

post.description: Cancels an in-progress or queued agent run, refunds any unspent credit holds, and marks the run status as cancelled.
Submits answers or actions to a suspended run waitpoint (e.g. human options questionnaire or plan mode approval). Resumes the agent run immediately.

requestBody.description: Response answers, skip flag, or plan action (run_all, step_by_step, request_changes)

200.description: Waitpoint response recorded and token completed

get.description: Returns visible tools from the registry with categories, descriptions, and estimated microcredits.
Returns full metadata for a single tool: display name, JSON schema of inputs for building forms, pricing lines, and default credit estimates.
Returns paginated direct execution history for a specific tool.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of runs to return (default 20, max 50)

post.description: Executes a single tool directly without LLM orchestration. Validates input schema, reserves credits, dispatches execution, and returns a realtime token for live updates.

requestBody.description: Validated tool input object matching the tool's inputSchema

get.description: Returns status, output, credit usage, generated assets, and a fresh realtime token for a direct tool execution.
Returns paginated image and video assets produced by tool invocations across all chats for the user.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of assets to return (default 20, max 50)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional filter by asset type: 'image' or 'video'

200.description: Paginated list of generated media assets
